name: Save the Krusty Krab 🍔
desc:
The Krusty Krab is in trouble, and it needs YOU to keep its doors open! Do you have what it takes to Save the Krusty Krab? 🍔

🧽 You’re hired! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick, Squidward, and more iconic characters from Bikini Bottom!

⏰ Clock in and get to work! Run the register, fire up the grill, assemble orders, and deliver food!
💰 Serve up iconic dishes, keep your customers happy, and bring in the MONEY!
⭐ Serve a large variety of customers, including villains, MVPs, and plenty of familiar faces!
🦠 Watch out for Plankton! He’s always cooking up trouble, and your shift is no exception!
🔧 Upgrade the Krusty Krab and power up your character to tackle even bigger challenges!

🚨 Every order counts! Can you save the Krusty Krab from BANKRUPTCY?!

🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
🔥 Like the game and join the community for exclusive rewards!

©2026 Viacom. SpongeBob SquarePants created by Stephen Hillenburg.

llm.loop: play Bikini Bottom characters -> run register, grill, assemble and deliver orders -> survive Plankton's sabotage -> upgrade the restaurant
llm.objectives: keep the Krusty Krab out of bankruptcy
llm.progression: restaurant and character upgrades, doubloons, badges
llm.instructions: clock in, cook and serve customers, watch out for Plankton
unique: officially licensed SpongeBob (Viacom) co-op restaurant survival
llm.thumbnails: high-quality SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward cooking burgers
llm.complexity_notes: licensed IP, multiple characters, cooking stations and customer AI
